headline: Brazilian Federal Court Suspends Restrictions on Three Betting Companies
summary: A federal appeals court in São Paulo authorized three betting companies to resume operations, suspending earlier restrictions and domain blocks.
why: Regulatory and legal rulings regarding online betting licenses impact gaming operators and tax revenue frameworks in Latin America's largest market.

impacts.name: Online Betting Sector
impacts.why: Lifting operational bans allows affected gaming companies to resume revenue generation.
